name: Cursed Ground
description: In the forest’s heart, trees covered in eerie luminescent fungi of purple and green hues show the advancement of a pervasive curse. These fungi, releasing hallucinogenic spores, are rumored to grant visions of potential futures. Amidst the eucalyptus trees and vibrant green moss, there are no animals, as here dwells fungal entities and plant beings such as myconids, violent fungus, otyughs, and treants, with many treants bearing fungal growths adorning their trunks and leaves. The fungus demonstrates collective intelligence, enabling it to sense and communicate across the forest. Though its purpose is mysterious, whispers suggest it may be a cursed human transformed into this state. The infected treants are under the fungus’ control, while myconids and other fungal creatures remain free, with the myconids even venerating the fungus as a deity despite receiving no divine magic in return. The fungus beckons people to the forest’s center, offering wisdom in exchange for accepting a curse.
